installer-gui-script.title: WittyMediaServer @DISPLAY_VERSION@
installer-gui-script.welcome:
WittyMediaServer is your own media server. This installs the app in Applications, and sets it to run in the background.
Your library, accounts and settings stay in your Library folder, and are kept when you update.
To remove it later, open Uninstall WittyMediaServer in Applications.

choice.title: WittyMediaServer
choice.description: The app, its command line and FFmpeg.

choice.title: Run in the background
choice.description: Starts the server when the Mac starts, even when nobody is signed in. Without this, it runs while the app is open.
